fact_text: The analyst viewed Cherat Cement's FY24 results favourably even though revenue was roughly flat and sales volumes had fallen.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: Cherat Cement's gross margin was about 30 to 31 percent in FY24.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: Cherat Cement reported EPS of about 8 rupees for FY24.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: The analyst said Cherat has absorbed much of the deferred tax impact, which supports its earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: Cherat's cement dispatches were about 22 lakh bags domestically and about 4 lakh bags to Afghanistan, roughly 26 lakh bags in total.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: The analyst expects cement dispatches to rise once consumption improves, linking that recovery to the GDP growth outlook.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: The analyst cited an expected GDP growth rate of 3.5 percent for FY25.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: Citi Pharma makes active pharmaceutical ingredients under agreements with Indian API companies and also sells consumer products, so the analyst treats it as partly fast-moving consumer goods.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: Dengue cases in Lahore had raised hospital demand for paracetamol, and the analyst said Citi Pharma's API for Panadol-type products was seeing heavy use.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan's growing population could help fast-moving consumer goods and pharma companies like Citi Pharma grow over time.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Cheerat Cement & Citi Pharma Stock Review | PSX Investment Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-23)
